decisions.reason: As a multi-model safety shoe line in the firm's core business that has already been carried forward another year, it reflects substantial sunk development, production, and channel commitment that management is unlikely to reverse quickly.

Although the supportive insole is less visible and more replaceable than a full footwear line, its continued presence and fit with the firm's protective-footwear system make management more likely to persist than to withdraw it now.
The ergonomic safety shoe series sits in a central product category and was publicly highlighted with its own page, so accumulated investment and visible commitment strongly favor continuation.

Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship direction of the firm and has remained on the market, management is highly committed strategically and publicly and is therefore very unlikely to drop it within the year.
